🇨🇳 中文说明"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"⭐ If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub — it shows me that the plugin is useful to you a"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"nd motivates me to keep developing it."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"🐛 If you find a bug or would like to request a feature, open a GitHub issue in any language — I will"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" review your proposal and implement useful suggestions in a future plugin version."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ⚡ Overview & Semantic Compression Focus"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> **Note on DSH Core vs Plugin Responsibility:**
> Context budgeting, token counting, tool result pr"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"uning (`head/middle/tail`), and spilling long results to disk (`dsh-spill-policy`, `dsh-compaction-t"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ool-result-pruner`, `dsh-token-meter`) are natively managed by the **DSH core (>= 0.1.5)**.
> **`dsh"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"-context-lens`** focuses strictly on what the core does not do — **semantic compression**:
> 1. **AS"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"T Code Skeletons**: Signatures, interfaces, exported types, and doc comments instead of whole functi"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"on/method bodies across 9+ languages.
> 2. **Path-Based Focus**: Full code for active editing target"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"s while surrounding workspace files remain skeletonized.
> 3. **Test & Build Log Compression**: Fail"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"ures, errors, stack traces, and test summary instead of raw multi-megabyte terminal streams."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## ✨ Features"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 1. 🧬 Multi-Language AST Structural Skeletonizer
* **Supported Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScrip"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"t, Python, Go, C/C++, Rust, Java, and SQL DDL.
* **Structural Preservation**: Retains imports, class"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"es, structs, interfaces, exported types, function signatures, and doc comments while discarding inne"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"r implementation bodies.
* **Multiline Signature Support**: Seamlessly accumulates complex multiline"},{"id":"p11s5","text":" generic arguments, return types, and parameter lists up to block delimiters.
* **Pure Regex Impleme"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ntation**: Zero heavy native dependencies or binary parser overhead; runs lightning-fast across any "},{"id":"p11s7","text":": Zero heavy native dependencies or binary parser overhead; runs lightning-fast across any platform."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### 2. 📋 Intelligent Test & Build Log Condenser
* **Supported Test Runners & Tools**: Jest, Vitest, "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"Pytest, `node --test`, Go test, Cargo, Webpack, Vite, TSC, Maven, Gradle.
* **Targeted Extraction**:"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" Identifies and preserves critical error messages, stack traces, assertion differences (`Expected .."},{"id":"p12s4","text":". Received ...`), and failure context windows.
* **Successful Run Summarization**: Automatically col"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"lapses passing runs (0 failures) into concise summary lines.
* **Auto-Mode Discrimination**: Evaluat"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"es command context and text signatures to ensure normal non-test outputs are preserved untouched for"},{"id":"p12s7","text":" core pruning.
* **3 Aggressiveness Modes**:
- `raw`: Removes noise lines while keeping general exec"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"ution order.
- `balanced`: Preserves failure sections with surrounding context windows (default).
- "},{"id":"p12s9","text":"`aggressive`: Extracts strictly error lines and stack frames."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### 3. 🎯 Path Focus Management
* Designate specific files or folders as active working targets for t"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"he current task.
* Files in focus bypass AST skeletonization, returning complete implementation code"},{"id":"p13s3","text":".
